Labels with boxes and labels that repel each other

Source: R/layers-label.R
geom_label_3d.Rd

geom_label_3d() draws text on a rounded box at each 3D position, like ggplot2::geom_label(). geom_text_repel_3d() and geom_label_repel_3d() move each label away from the other labels and from the data points, and join a moved label to its point with a leader line, as in the ggrepel package's geom_text_repel() and geom_label_repel().

Usage

geom_label_3d(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  stat = "identity",
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  parse = FALSE,
  label.padding = grid::unit(0.25, "lines"),
  label.r = grid::unit(0.15, "lines"),
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

geom_text_repel_3d(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  stat = "identity",
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  parse = FALSE,
  box.padding = 0.25,
  point.padding = 1e-06,
  min.segment.length = 0.5,
  force = 1,
  force_pull = 1,
  max.time = Inf,
  max.iter = 10000,
  max.overlaps = getOption("ggplot3d.max.overlaps", default = 10),
  nudge_x = 0,
  nudge_y = 0,
  xlim = c(NA, NA),
  ylim = c(NA, NA),
  direction = c("both", "y", "x"),
  seed = NA,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

geom_label_repel_3d(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  stat = "identity",
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  parse = FALSE,
  box.padding = 0.25,
  label.padding = grid::unit(0.25, "lines"),
  point.padding = 1e-06,
  label.r = grid::unit(0.15, "lines"),
  min.segment.length = 0.5,
  force = 1,
  force_pull = 1,
  max.time = Inf,
  max.iter = 10000,
  max.overlaps = getOption("ggplot3d.max.overlaps", default = 10),
  nudge_x = 0,
  nudge_y = 0,
  xlim = c(NA, NA),
  ylim = c(NA, NA),
  direction = c("both", "y", "x"),
  seed = NA,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

Arguments

mapping, data, stat, position, ..., na.rm, show.legend, inherit.aes

Standard ggplot2 layer arguments.

parse

Whether to parse labels as plotmath expressions.

label.padding, label.r

Padding around the text and corner radius of the box, as grid units or numbers of lines.

box.padding

Space kept free around each label box, as a grid unit or a number of lines (default 0.25).

point.padding

Space kept free around each data point, as a grid unit or a number of lines.

min.segment.length

Leader lines shorter than this are not drawn, as a grid unit or a number of lines (default 0.5). Inf draws none, 0 draws every leader of a label that does not cover its point.

force

Strength of the push between overlapping labels and between a label and a data point it covers (default 1).

force_pull

Strength of the pull of each label back to its point (default 1).

max.time

Maximum solver time in seconds per panel. The default Inf leaves the iteration count as the only limit, so a seeded layout is the same on every machine.

max.iter

Maximum number of solver iterations (default 10000).

max.overlaps

A label that overlaps more than this number of other labels and data points where it starts is not drawn. Defaults to the option ggplot3d.max.overlaps, or 10.

nudge_x, nudge_y

Starting offset of each label from its point, in millimetres on the page (default 0).

xlim, ylim

Range the labels stay within, as fractions of the panel width and height. NA stands for the panel edge.

direction

Move labels in both directions (default), or only along "x" or "y" of the page.

seed

Seed of the random starting directions. NA (default) draws one from R's random number generator at each draw.

Value

A ggplot2 layer.

Details

Labels are placed on the page when the panel is drawn, after projection, so they never overlap whatever the camera angle. A force-directed solver in C++ moves the label boxes: overlapping boxes push each other apart along the line between their centres, every data point of the layer pushes boxes off its disc of radius point.size plus point.padding, and a spring pulls each box back until it touches its own point. Each step keeps part of the previous velocity, which damps oscillation. The solver stops once no box overlaps and the boxes are at rest.

Rows with an empty or missing label are not drawn but still push labels away. The repelled labels and their leader lines are drawn over the scene, not hidden by surfaces in front of their points. animate_3d() starts each frame's labels from their offsets in the previous frame, matched by label text, so labels keep their side of the point while the camera moves. view_3d() does not show repelled labels.

Extra aesthetics of the repel layers: point.size (size of the data points to keep clear of, in the units of the size aesthetic of points, default 1.5), segment.colour, segment.size, segment.alpha and segment.linetype (leader colour, width in mm, opacity and line type; default the label colour, 0.5, the label opacity and solid).

Examples

d <- data.frame(x = c(1, 1.1, 1.2, 2, 3), y = c(1, 1.1, 1, 2, 1),
                z = c(1, 1.2, 1.1, 2, 3), name = c("alpha", "beta", "gamma", "delta", "epsilon"))
p <- ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x, y, z = z, label = name)) + geom_point_3d()
p + geom_label_3d(fill = "white") + coord_3d()
p + geom_text_repel_3d(seed = 1) + coord_3d()
p + geom_label_repel_3d(seed = 1, segment.colour = "grey40") + coord_3d()
